papers.title_en: On a bulk-surface Navier-Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard model: Existence of weak solutions and asymptotic limits
papers.evidence: 含质量传递和移动接触线的两相流体-表面纳维-斯托克斯-卡恩-希利亚德模型
papers.tldr: 针对具有移动接触线、可变接触角及质量传递的两相流，本文研究热力学一致的体-表面 Navier-Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard 系统，该模型同时耦合体相和表面相的守恒律及自由能泛函。通过隐式时间离散和次微分刻画构造逼近解，证明非退化迁移率与奇异势下全局弱解的存在性。进一步分析高摩擦与解耦同时极限，证明弱解收敛到 Abels-Garcke-Grün 模型，其中体-表面自由能凸部分的 Mosco 收敛是关键技术，具有独立的数学价值。
papers.abstract_en: We study a thermodynamically consistent bulk-surface Navier--Stokes--Cahn--Hilliard system describing two-phase flows exhibiting moving contact lines, variable contact angles, and mass transfer. We establish the existence of global weak solutions for non-degenerate mobility functions and singular free-energy potentials. The proof is based on an implicit time-discretization scheme and a subdifferential characterization of the convex part of the bulk-surface free energy. Finally, we study the simultaneous high-friction and decoupling limit, and prove that corresponding weak solutions converge, up to a subsequence, to a weak solution of the Abels--Garcke--Grün model. One key ingredient of the proof is the Mosco convergence of the convex part of the bulk-surface free energy, which might be of independent interest.
